text: {"label":"Skill Teaching for Intellectual Disabilities","definition":"Instructional interventions that teach academic, social, play, life, and vocational skills to students and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities, often delivered by educators, staff, or volunteers in schools.","distinct_from_neighbours":"It centres on teaching new skills broadly, not on communication modality and augmentative systems, assessing and treating challenging behavior, or supported employment outcomes for adults."}
